errors.text_span: The horizontal axis contains the categories labeled “Exp. Length,” shown in ascending order at 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, and 35
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the x-axis tick marks (5, 10, 15, etc.) as discrete categories. The chart is a histogram-like plot where these numbers represent the boundaries of the bins for the six bars, not seven distinct categories.
The chart displays only six bars. The description invents a seventh data point for a category at "Exp. Length" 35, which does not exist.
The description incorrectly states the value for the category "30" is 0.31. This likely refers to the sixth bar (spanning 30 to 35 on the x-axis), whose height is approximately 0.345, not 0.31.
The description incorrectly identifies the bar associated with "30" (the sixth bar) as the shortest. The fifth bar (spanning 25 to 30) is visually the shortest, with a value of approximately 0.32.
